name: Featherkin
look: Owl-like sprite with a feather cape
proportions: 2.2 heads, eyes 22% of face width, set low and wide
personality: Curious and easily distracted; the first to investigate anything new
at_home: Perches on the highest thing it can find and preens
ability: Glides 3 tiles in one move, crossing a gap and rising or dropping one height level on the way. Two uses a heist

name: Skyskipper
look: Long-eared hopper with a big satchel
personality: Eager and clumsy; drops things and picks them straight back up
at_home: Practises hops over a fence until it trips
ability: Stuffs its satchel: loads at 60 a second instead of 30 for 5 s. Two uses a heist

name: Rambler
personality: Stubborn and cheerful; charges first, apologises after
at_home: Headbutts a boulder in the yard, slowly
ability: Charges 4 tiles in a straight line and breaks the first wall, hedge or boulder in its way. Two uses a heist
resists: Immune to being pushed by Current or Tilt
sound: a low grunt and a dusty crash

name: Glass Golem
look: Tall faceted crystal body with an inner light
personality: Quiet and patient; stands where it is put
at_home: Stands at the edge watching the sky for hours
ability: Raises a crystal wall 3 tiles long for 6 s: nothing passes it, and it does not block sight. Two uses a heist
resists: Takes half damage from Spark laws

name: Quarryback
look: Armadillo with a stone shell and a pick tail
proportions: 2.1 heads, round back, small eyes set low
personality: Grumpy and methodical; finishes what it starts
at_home: Digs a hole, fills it in, digs it again
ability: Pounds: for 6 s its hits on the Vault, pylons and wards deal 50% more. Two uses a heist

name: Prism Mite
look: Tiny prism bug with a backpack
personality: Bright and busy; talks to itself constantly
at_home: Splits in two and plays with itself
ability: Splits into two mites for 8 s, each with half its load and half its health; they can go different ways, a caught mite loses only its half, and they rejoin when it ends. Two uses a heist
resists: Sees through Glass and Mirror images

name: Tidewalker
look: Otter-like wader with a shell pack
proportions: 2.3 heads, soft muzzle, big low eyes
at_home: Floats on its back in the pond
ability: For 6 s nothing slows it: terrain, laws and its own load leave it at full speed. Two uses a heist

name: Hourkeeper
personality: Precise and fussy; hates being interrupted
at_home: Turns its hourglass over and watches it drain
ability: Gives one ally back all the health it lost in the last 5 s. Two uses a heist
sound: a soft tick and a chime

name: Stillwatch
at_home: Stands on one leg, motionless, all evening
ability: Freezes one guard or ward for 2.5 s: it cannot move, act, see or grow suspicious. Two uses a heist

name: Emberling
personality: Excitable and reckless; cannot stand still
ability: Bursts, dealing triple its Power at once to every ward and pylon within 1 tile. Two uses a heist
resists: Immune to Heat bloom and ember vents
sound: a struck match and a whoosh

name: Stormhound
look: Lean fox-hound with a lightning mane
personality: Loyal and impatient; runs ahead and comes back
at_home: Chases its own sparks in circles
ability: Sprints 60% faster for 4 s. Two uses a heist
resists: Immune to Static and Chain lightning
sound: a crackle and a happy yip

name: Sparkwright
look: Little tinker with a coil backpack
personality: Chatty and inventive; explains things nobody asked about
at_home: Rewires the lantern, badly, then fixes it
ability: Cuts the Sage's cooldown by 10 s, so its next power comes sooner (11.7). Two uses a heist

name: Mossbear
personality: Gentle and slow; the one everyone leans on
at_home: Sleeps in the sun while flowers grow on its back
ability: Roots in place for 6 s, taking half damage; it cannot move while rooted. Two uses a heist
sound: a deep hum and creaking wood

name: Bloomling
personality: Sweet and shy; hides behind bigger crew members
at_home: Waters the garden, including the stones
ability: Heals every ally within 3 tiles by 15% of its full health, at once. Two uses a heist
sound: a small bell and rustling petals

name: Rootrunner
personality: Practical and tidy; always carrying something
at_home: Rearranges the garden into neat rows
ability: Grows a root bridge over one gap of up to 3 tiles for 8 s; anyone can cross it, guards included. Two uses a heist

name: Echoplate
look: Hollow armour with a wisp inside
personality: Formal and brave; speaks rarely and kindly
ability: Stands over the crew for 8 s: a crew member knocked out within 3 tiles of it, itself included, returns at once at 40% of its full health (12.20). Two uses a heist
sound: armour settling and a soft chord

name: Lantern Wisp
personality: Playful and nosy; drifts toward anything hidden
at_home: Lights every lantern in the realm, one by one
ability: Reveals every hidden ward, hidden guard and illusion within 6 tiles for 6 s. Two uses a heist
resists: Cannot be hidden by Glowing dark
sound: a warm flicker and a hush

name: Soulmender
proportions: 2.4 heads, soft wings, large dark eyes
personality: Quiet and watchful; notices who is struggling
at_home: Sits with whoever lost a heist that day
ability: Links the crew for 6 s: every hit on one of them is shared evenly across all. Two uses a heist
